lastCompletedStory.title: Dashboard accepts orchPane, renders a command keybar, and dispatches n/r/s/p/i + d via injectable runTmux

nextStoryContext: US-003 added orchPane + runTmux props to DashboardApp (src/ui/Dashboard.tsx). KEYBAR_COMMANDS constant (n/r/s/p/i) lives in Dashboard.tsx, mirroring Menu.tsx's COMMANDS. useInput now handles n/r/s/p/i (send-keys to orchPane), d (select-pane to orchPane), q/Ctrl+C (exit). Standalone mode (orchPane undefined) makes dispatch keys inert no-ops. runDashboardInk in src/commands/dashboard.ts accepts orchPane and threads it through. index.ts parses an optional positional orchPane from argv[3]. 9 new tests added to test/dashboard.test.ts using stdin.write() from ink-testing-library to simulate keypresses and assert runTmux call args. All 790 tests pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: useInput(input, key) signature confirmed: key.ctrl, key.return, key.escape flags present. Implementation matches. ink-testing-library stdin.write emits data events that trigger useInput; confirmed via passing tests.
